notes.segment: The engine can't replace a single MP4 segment: render runs as one composition, and mastering re-encodes the whole file. The whole video gets rebuilt — voice, sound, and frames come from cache.
notes.revoice: The beat's old take is moved to history/, the rest of the lines come from cache.

form.atHint: a line word, start, speech, end, or seconds

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet — start with “New video”
projects.duplicateHint: id of the new copy: lowercase Latin letters, digits, and hyphens. project.json, media.json, media/, voice/, and research.md are copied; build, renders, and history are not.

project.changedOutside: {files} changed outside the panel — cards reloaded

beats.about: Any field writes to project.json; manual JSON edits still work. Field lists and types come from the engine's device.json, scene.json, and schema.json.
beats.seesHint: One director's sentence before picking an intent (research.md → Beats).
beats.roleHint: Role in the arc: hook, setup, turn, peak, ending… (library/arcs).

groups.caption: Beat captions
groups.advanced: Sources, pauses, and the beat's full JSON

beats.intentStageHint: Optional: stage fields on top of the intent default (e.g. src).
beats.explainsHint: What the annotation explains — required for annotate.*
beats.maxDevices: No more than 3 devices per beat
beats.captionHint: Empty — defaults to the look and the video. Presets by family:
beats.syncHint: voice — by words, music — by the track's beats, both
beats.cameraHint: A stage beat's camera moves only with a reason
beats.savedInvalid: Saved, but the project doesn't build:
beats.previewHint: Preview without voice: words are spread across the clip over ~3–9 s, rendered at 540×960.
beats.rebuildText: The engine can't replace a single segment in the MP4 — the whole video will be rebuilt (≈ 4–6 min, voice and frames from cache). Continue?
beats.revoiceNote: The old take will move to history/, and the video will be rebuilt with this beat's new take.
beats.removeText: A snapshot of project.json from before the deletion will stay in history/.

assets.drop: Drop images, video, or audio here —
assets.redBanner: No license: {n}. These files show red, and the build won't let them through.
assets.allGreen: All {n} files are licensed in media.json
assets.roleHint: hero — the world's main picture, evidence — a document or archival footage, place — where it is
assets.title: title
assets.author: author
assets.urlHint: The file's page on Commons / Pexels — goes into the video description
assets.removeText: media/{name} and its entry in media.json will be deleted.
assets.trimHint: Saved to media.json → trim and used as the beat’s in/out when the beat sets none.
assets.searchAbout: same as npm run media, just licenses PD, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, and Pexels
assets.nothing: Nothing found — try shorter or different words
assets.noPexels: No Pexels key — searched Commons only
assets.added: File downloaded, entry added to media.json

publish.none: No publish/ yet — build the video with render
publish.markText: Status becomes “published”, date is today (in project.json).

verify.none: No auto-check report yet — build the video
verify.fixDefault: open the build log and the renders/<id>.verify.json report
verify.warnDefault: check passed, but look at the warnings on the contact sheet

format.title: Format and duration
format.fix: MP4 isn't 1080×1920 / 30 fps, or runs longer than planned — rebuild; if the duration is off, check transitions (TRAPS “Лишние кадры”)

size.title: File size
size.fix: more than 25 MB per 10 s — check bitrate.crf in settings (18 by default)

loudness.title: Loudness
loudness.fix: not −14 LUFS, or peak above −1.5 dBTP — rebuild: mastering runs during the build

blank.title: Blank scenes
blank.fix: the MP4 has a blank beat — check the frame on the sheet, usually it's media without a file or a layer covering it

frozen.title: Frozen scenes
frozen.fix: a beat doesn't move, or an event doesn't change the frame — add motion (camera with a reason, a device) or check the event word
frozen.warn: check the beats listed on the sheet

settled.title: Frames = snapshots
settled.fix: the MP4 frame diverges from the composition snapshot — check the sheet; video still playing at the settle moment can't be compared

sources.title: Sources for numbers
sources.fix: an on-screen number has no reference — add source to the device or sources.text to the beat

media.title: Media licenses
media.fix: in the “Assets” tab, fill in the red entries: source, author, license, link

grammar.title: Beat grammar
grammar.fix: fix the beat named in the error text: one stage, ≤ 3 devices, dominant, explains on annotations
grammar.warn: pacing: a pause after a dense beat, no consecutive intents, text ≤ 7 words

expanded.title: Intent expansion
expanded.fix: the resolver gave a different result — report it in the engine session

uniqueness.title: Uniqueness
uniqueness.fix: the video resembles one of the last two: change the look, arc, or stage sequence

publish.title: Publish
publish.fix: titles, tags, or credits are missing — fill in publish in project.json and rebuild

text.title: On-screen text
text.fix: contrast under captions is below 4.5:1 without a backing — set background on the beat's captions
text.warn: the engine auto-applied a wash or blur — check the frame

history.none: History is empty — a snapshot will appear before the first rebuild
history.about: A snapshot of project.json and media.json is taken before every rebuild, rollback, beat deletion, and library item application (if something changed).
history.rollbackText: project.json and media.json will revert to the {name} snapshot. The current state will move to history first.
history.rolledBack: Rolled back to {name}; previous state saved as {saved}

library.title: Library
library.noPreview: no preview yet — npm run library:previews

applyHint.devices: The device is added to the beat (max 3); parameters come from the demo — adjust them in the “Beats” tab.
applyHint.textures: The texture is added to the beat on top of the look's textures.
applyHint.set: The beat's field will be replaced with this item.
applyHint.project: The project's field will be replaced with this item.

library.appliedInvalid: Saved, but the project doesn't build: {e}
library.addTrackHint: The track goes into library/music/, the entry into music.json, and the beat grid is computed once. A track without a license won't be added.

looks.title: Look
looks.sub: Video worlds: default palette, textures, camera, captions
looks.createHint: A new world starts from a built-in one: anything not set comes from the base. Saved to library/looks/<id>/look.json and checked by the engine right away.
looks.name: name
looks.sampleHint: The line on the world’s preview, e.g. 18 hours or Why is the sky blue?

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: hygen.config.json — every command reads it. Secrets go only in .env.

about.voice: Default provider and voice; project.json and the --voice flag take precedence.
about.budgets: ElevenLabs character cap since the last reset.
about.short: Target line length for the director.
about.paths: Where projects and the library live.

settings.secretsAbout: Values aren't shown or edited from the panel — only whether they're set.
settings.extraEnv: Non-secret values found in .env: {list} — move them to hygen.config.json
settings.languageAbout: Only the panel interface in this browser; videos, the engine and CLI messages do not change.

newvideo.title: New video
newvideo.sub: Brief → /short director in Claude Code → assets → beats → build → publish
newvideo.lookHint: look “director” — let the director decide based on the topic.
newvideo.claudeMissing: claude not found in PATH or ~/.local/bin — the director can only run manually from Claude Code
newvideo.checkOk: Checked {d}: claude -p responds with a subscription ({s} s)
newvideo.manual: Run the director in Claude Code from the repo root using the command below — the panel will pick up project.json once it appears.
newvideo.directorFail: Director stopped with an error — see log
newvideo.projectAppeared: project.json appeared — the project is ready to edit

director.title: Director
director.homeSub: The panel terminal and the director’s journal — pick a project
director.manual: Made by hand: the project has no director.log — the panel’s director did not make it. Below is what the project files hold.
director.allowlistAbout: Anything not on the list is refused (--permission-mode dontAsk); every refusal is written to director.log.
director.noBrief: No brief — the project was not started from “New video”
director.whyChosen: what was chosen and why (research.md → Media)

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.stopText: The shell and everything running in it (claude included) will be stopped.
terminal.noXterm: xterm.js did not load: {e} — run npm install in the repository root
